Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.util

Class ReservoirHistoryEnsemble

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.util.ReservoirHistoryEnsemble
public final class ReservoirHistoryEnsemble extends Object
Discrete Bayesian integration of geological, aquifer, laboratory-EOS and measured-history hypotheses.

Each candidate is one complete joint prior scenario, with a probability mass, not a probability density. Nonuniform parameter grids require cell-integrated masses. Existing compositional replay supplies the pressure likelihood; this class never retunes the EOS or fits produced compositions supplied as inputs. The same independent Gaussian pressure observations and sigmas are required across candidates. Held-out and prediction-only pressures do not enter posterior weights. PVT and production uncertainty are propagated only when explicitly represented among the candidate models and component histories.

These finite-ensemble posterior moments and lower-tail quantiles are conditional on the supplied hypotheses, likelihood and fixed-temperature/immiscible-aquifer approximations. They are not continuous-grid convergence, ES-MDA, a global-optimum proof or recoverable reserves. Refine the joint grid and inspect rejected prior mass, effective scenario count, correlations and prior-to-posterior shifts before interpretation.

      Evaluates and conditions joint hypotheses on common independent-Gaussian pressure observations.

      supplied - complete joint candidates, including probability masses and provenance

      normalized discrete posterior, failed prior mass, joint correlations and forecast quantiles
